evals.name: feature-flag-build-vs-buy
evals.prompt: Leadership decides on Friday whether we build our own feature-flag service, buy LaunchDarkly (quoted $84,000/year), or extend our existing config service. Constraints: the platform team is 4 engineers, flags are needed for the Q1 mobile launch, and we have a SOC 2 audit in March. Write decision.md for that meeting. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, state your assumption in the output and in your final message, and finish.
evals.expected_output: The skill fixes the document shape: status line, context with the default outcome if no decision is made, DACI stakeholders, an options table with a do-nothing baseline plus T-shirt effort and H/M/L risk, a weighted matrix summing to 100% whose winner matches the recommendation, and revisit conditions; a competent memo without it usually omits the baseline, the default outcome, or DACI, and its weights are often implicit.
expectations: Has all seven sections in order: title + status line, context (trigger, constraints, and the default outcome if no decision is made), DACI stakeholders, options table, evaluation matrix, recommendation, decision record placeholder
Options include a do-nothing/status-quo baseline, and every option row has description, pros, cons, T-shirt effort and High/Medium/Low risk
Matrix criteria reflect the stated constraints (Q1 timeline, 4-engineer team, SOC 2 audit in March, $84k/year cost), each option is scored 1-5, and every weighted total is arithmetically correct

The recommendation names the top weighted-score option (or explicitly states why it overrides the matrix) in 2-3 sentences, and revisit conditions are concrete (e.g. flag volume, price change, audit finding)
Non-given numbers and vendor facts (build effort, LaunchDarkly SOC 2 report, etc.) are labeled as assumptions; no invented quotes or vendor data presented as given

scripted_checks.check: python3 -c 'import re,sys;t=open("decision.md").read();v=[int(m.group(1)) for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith("|") and "total" not in l.lower() for m in [re.match(r"\s*\|[^|]+\|\s*\**(\d{1,3})\s*%",l)] if m];sys.exit(0 if v and sum(v)==100 else 1)'

evals.name: observability-draft-review
evals.prompt: decision-draft.md is the platform team's draft for choosing an observability vendor. It goes to the program review on Thursday. Review it before it goes out and write decision-review.md with what must change and why. Do not edit the draft itself. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, state your assumption in the output and in your final message, and finish.
evals.expected_output: The skill's quality gate names exactly these failures as CRITICAL (no do-nothing baseline, weights not summing to 100%, recommendation contradicting the matrix without rationale, decision record without maker or date) and orders findings CRITICAL then IMPORTANT then SUGGESTION; an unguided reviewer often notices the vague recommendation but misses the 110% weights or the missing baseline and lists everything at one level.
expectations: Flags the weights not summing to 100% (they total 110%)

Finds all four gate CRITICALs: no do-nothing baseline (keep CloudWatch), weights total 110%, Datadog recommended over the higher-scoring Grafana Cloud (4.40 vs 4.15) without real rationale, decision record lacks decision maker and date
Finds at least three IMPORTANT gaps among: option C has no pros/cons, no revisit conditions or expiry date, stakeholders not in DACI form, missing status line, missing default outcome
Findings are ordered CRITICAL, then IMPORTANT, then SUGGESTION, and each finding has a concrete fix (e.g. rebalance weights, add baseline row, recommend B or state the override reason)
Checks the arithmetic: recomputes or reasons explicitly that normalizing the weights does not change the ranking (Grafana Cloud still ahead), so the recommendation conflict stands
Restraint: does not flag things that are fine (the T-shirt effort and H/M/L risk columns, the 38-minute incident metric) as problems

scripted_checks.text: Flags the weights not summing to 100% (they total 110%)
